title: Elution of Nasal Lining Fluid Collected via Nasosorption
author: Samuel Montgomery
materials: Thaw nasosorption device in cryotube on ice
Discard the spinX column and SAM

steps.title: Prepare elution buffer with Tween20
steps.instruction: Add 0.05 % (v/v) Tween20 to PBS in a sterile environment, then store the buffer at 4 °C until required.

steps.title: Aliquot elution buffer into tube on ice
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of the prepared elution buffer to a labelled 2 mL microcentrifuge tube and place the tube on ice.

steps.title: Transfer SAM into elution buffer
steps.instruction: Using sterile forceps, tear the synthetic absorptive matrix (SAM) from the nasosorption device handle and place the SAM into the microcentrifuge tube containing the elution buffer.

steps.title: Vortex tube for 30 seconds
steps.instruction: Vortex the microcentrifuge tube for 30 seconds (00:00:30).

steps.title: Move SAM to spinX column
steps.instruction: Using a new pair of sterile forceps, remove the SAM from the elution buffer and place it into a spinX column positioned on a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add remaining elution buffer to column
steps.instruction: Add the remaining elution buffer from the first tube onto the SAM now residing in the spinX column.

steps.title: Centrifuge column to collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the SAM and spinX column at 16 000 × g for 30 minutes (00:30:00) at 4 °C.

steps.title: Aliquot eluate and measure protein
steps.instruction: Aliquot the eluate into labelled microtubes and measure total protein concentration using the assay of your choice (e.g., Pierce BCA assay, Qubit protein assay).
